items.Sentence: The Marina Dechlorination Facility dechlorinates treated and disinfected effluent from the EBDA and LAVWMA member agencies using sodium bisulfite.

EBDA may accept and discharge up to 2 MGD of brine composed of mixed sea salts ... The brine would be blended with EBDA’s effluent for disposal. This project would include the construction of a pipeline from the Newark facility to the EBDA pipeline.
